rule_cited: Four Quadrants (growth-up tilt) + markets discount the future, not the present
teach: Wait for a confirmed bounce, not a falling price, before buying stocks after a steep monthly drop.
why: Stocks fell almost seven percent this month; I want proof buyers have returned before adding any shares.

rule_cited: Diversification is the holy grail (spread the growth-down bet across bond maturities, not just long bonds)
teach: Spreading one bet across several related assets lowers bumps in the ride without giving up the protection.
why: My long bonds already bet on slower growth; medium-term bonds make the same bet with smaller price swings.
